label: rem:adelic-tate-bsd-reduction
title: Adelic Fourier transform gives the BSD leading-coefficient prefactor as a local-squeeze check
html:
Remark. Adelic Fourier transform gives the BSD leading-coefficient prefactor as a local-squeeze check

BSD reduction. The leading-coefficient form of BSD requires identifying the standard-real prefactor c in L(\mathcal{E}_q, s) \asymp c \cdot (s - 1)^r. The adelic Fourier transform of adelic Tate squeeze gives the explicit formula for c in terms of local \varepsilon_p-adic integrals.
